construction_rule: Cross-asset lead-lag: industrial metals composite (lead variable) and commodity-exporting-nation currencies (lag variable). LEAD: equal-weighted composite of certified industrial metals (HG copper). TRIGGER: top-decile absolute return of lead, measured to session t. LAG: commodity-currency futures (AUD, CAD, NZD certified on R38) entered at next available session, held 3 sessions. OBSERVABILITY: last session on which BOTH metals composite and traded currency are quoted; mixed-calendar rule applied.
observability_instant: t-2 for OI; signal instant is last session where both metals and FX quoted (mixed-calendar observability). Both metals and FX trade different schedules; decision uses union grid (15 exchanges, 260-261 sessions/yr).
zero_is_missing_rule: open_interest == 0 is MISSING data. Usable OI >= 80% floor per market-session over decision-eligible range. Mixed-calendar rule: currency unscorable if OI missing on >20% of triggered decisions.

lead_component.name: industrial_metals_composite
lead_component.construction: equal-weighted daily return of HG (copper), measured to t
lead_component.trigger_rule: top_decile of absolute 3-session return (252-session rolling distribution)
lead_component.trigger_frequency_expectation: fires on ~10% of decisions (sparse by design)

excluded.reason: Not commodity-exporting nations' primary currencies. GBP commodity importer; JPY traded currency but Japan not commodity exporter; MXN and CHF not certified as primary commodity-exporter currency on R38. Only AUD (Australia), CAD (Canada), NZD (New Zealand) qualify per director's specification.

limitations: Sparse by design: top-decile trigger fires ~10% of sessions (rough 84 rebalances/yr)
Mixed-calendar observability: metals trade US hours, FX trade 24-hour currency futures; decision instant is last session both are quoted
Open interest is provisional at t-1; observability_instant t-2 is binding for OI checks
Cost binding constraint: at 0.20%/yr roll + 3-session h budget, max mean turnover per period is 0.333 at 5bp, 0.167 at 10bp; sparse book expected to stay within ceiling
Metals composite is single market (HG); no group demeaning; if HG unscorable on decision, entire book is flat
Currency unscorable if >20% of triggered decisions missing OI; market then treated NaN (no forward-fill look-ahead)
